summary: Birkenstock Holding plc, via its indirect subsidiary Birkenstock Group B.V. Co. KG, announced the offering of €900M aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2033. Proceeds will be used to redeem €428.5M of outstanding 5.25% Senior Notes due 2029, finance share repurchases, refinance other debt, and pay fees. The notes are senior unsecured and expected to be listed on The International Stock Exchange. This is a debt refinancing and capital management transaction, not a special situation event. No merger, tender offer, or activist activity is involved. Watch for pricing and completion risk; no premium or share price impact directly.
